mapper.sql: /* 설 명 : 과목별학습진도목록조회쿼리 */ SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY LP.REG_DTTM) AS LINE_NO , LP.* , U.USERNM , U.STDNT_NO , ATNDLC.SCYR FROM TB_LMS_LRN_PRGRT LP JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON U.USER_ID = LP.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC ON U.USER_ID = ATNDLC.USER_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND LP.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId}
mapper.select: /* 설 명 : 과목별학습진도수조회 */ SELECT COUNT(LP.SBJCT_ID) AS TOTAL_CNT FROM TB_LMS_LRN_PRGRT LP JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON U.USER_ID = LP.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC ON U.USER_ID = ATNDLC.USER_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND LP.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId}
